card.line: Etam was a place in Judah where Samson hid in a rocky cave from the Philistines, and later a town King Rehoboam strengthened for defense.

moments.title: Samson hides in the cave
moments.text: After Samson struck the Philistines with a great slaughter, he went down and stayed in the cave at the rock of Etam.

moments.title: Judah comes for Samson
moments.text: Three thousand men of Judah came to the cave at Etam to arrest Samson and give him to the Philistines. Samson let them tie him with two new ropes and lead him up from the rock.

moments.title: Rehoboam fortifies Etam
moments.text: King Rehoboam built up Etam with other cities in Judah for defense. He strengthened their walls and put officers, supplies, shields, and spears in them.
